cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(goose_nest_native LANGUAGES C)
find_package(CURL 7.85 REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)
find_package(LibArchive REQUIRED)
add_library(goose_nest_native STATIC native/nest.c)
target_compile_features(goose_nest_native PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_definitions(goose_nest_native PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
target_compile_options(goose_nest_native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(goose_nest_native PUBLIC CURL::libcurl OpenSSL::Crypto LibArchive::LibArchive)
set_target_properties(goose_nest_native PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
